scientific_integrity: Every one of 708588 states examined by independently constructed reverse-functional-graph and forward-trajectory algorithms. Full graph definitions, code, integer trajectory witnesses and expected counts are supplied. The theorem is computationally proved, not symbolically generalized.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computer-assisted classifications of the specifically labelled 11-vertex Groetzsch and 12-vertex Chvatal graphs only; not a general assertion for all triangle-free four-chromatic graphs. The two full-state programs are not independent external validation. Earlier equivalent unindexed enumerations cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Sharp two-contact extinction on the two canonical triangle-free four-chromatic graphs
